name: Grainient
author: E. T. Carter
description: A grainy multi-point mesh gradient at full chroma. Seven colour points wander slow orbits across the whole frame, bleeding into one another along soft organic seams and slowly trading hues so the field never settles, while a dense film grain boils in the flats. The bright, tactile web-background gradient rather than a soft wash.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How fast the colour points wander and the seams bleed; 0 holds the field nearly still.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: Reach of each colour point; low gives tight pure pools with wide blends, high lets each hue flood further before it meets the next.

params.label: Bleed
params.effect: Organic warp of the blend boundaries; 0 gives clean round pools, high tears the seams into ragged bleeds.

params.label: Remix
params.effect: How fast the points trade palette hues with each other; 0 pins each pool to one colour.

params.label: Chroma
params.effect: Saturation push on the mixed field; 1 is the raw blend, higher pulls the seams back out to full palette colour.

params.label: Grain
params.effect: Strength of the baked film grain; 0 is a clean gradient, high is a coarse boiling texture.

params.label: Grain size
params.effect: Grain cell size in device pixels; 1 is fine film, larger is a chunkier print-like speckle.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the colour field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
